access_levels.dataset_processed: Dataset downloaded and processed by tools/etl/extract_datasets.py. Values are copied; the dataset's own quality code is mapped to our quality scale.
access_levels.census_figure: Official census total as reproduced in a standard statistical compendium. Used directly.
access_levels.reference_work: Standard scholarly reference cited at work level. The specific page was NOT checked in this build. Facts resting only on reference works are capped at quality 'supported'.

policy.rule: No source may be cited for a claim it does not cover. If a value could not be traced to any listed source it must be marked 'missing' or carry an explicit estimation method.
